goldDefinition: Gold marks earlier Scenes in wl-main, readable by the reader at S2, in which a person the selected ferryman Bren carried across appears. Only Lio's crossing is disclosed to this query; Kit's crossing belongs to the alternate worldline, Ora's has an unresolved worldline, Tam's review Scene has no Scope, and Sel's is known only to Mott. Lio's crossing Scene is Gold 3 and Lio's market Scene Gold 2.

measurementBoundary.contractBaseline: The isolated validator recomputes Graph traversal, Scene association, one-slot fusion and scorer arithmetic from these predeclared rows; it never runs Raw, IR or Graph.
measurementBoundary.runtimeSetup: Requires normal Scene/Scope/registry/Entity/Relation/pin/foreshadow writers, normal Chronicle provider/Proposal/child/Decision setup for qualifiedIr, and the normal typed Entity/Relation prepare plus Human Decision route for every revision. Runtime IDs issued by writers are mapped to these logical IDs in a setup receipt; Gold never stores runtime IDs.
measurementBoundary.setupOrder: Create the project and every Scene (including S2) in reading order; then Codex entities and relations; then the Scope registry and every explicit Scene Scope; then foreshadows, foreshadow Codex links and pins. Before the first setupTimeline step, enable maintenance through the real runtime-policy setting (the product default is maintenance_enabled=0; never through SQL or injected state; precondition maintenance-enabled). Then follow setupTimeline in order: each revision is prepared against its review Scene and receives its declared decision, each mutation uses its normal writer, and the qualified-ir step creates every qualifiedIr through the normal fixture provider/Proposal/child/Decision route with optional story inputs disabled only through real planner settings. Do not change tree order, registry or Scene Scope after the first typed revision is prepared. Then wait for the variant measurementPoint, record whether each declared precondition holds, and compare only the expectations that no unmet precondition blocks.
measurementBoundary.graphConnection: The appended Graph-only Scene needs target-Scene body disclosure (C-body). While that authority is Hold, the predeclared appended Scene cannot be returned and this case stays Hold; the Graph DTO comparison (nodes and edges) does not depend on C-body and is still made. The fixture sets no explicit POV or story position: if CB-4 requires either to judge the appended Scene, only the appended-Scene sub-expectation is blocked:cb4-inputs, and the Graph DTO and the unchanged R+IR prefix are still compared. Because control IR may stay below the IR floor, CP-3a must also append on a raw R+IR basis.
measurementBoundary.goldOrigin: Predeclared for this case before any Graph runtime observation; not selected from observed output and not a human author measurement.
measurementBoundary.setupRefusal: If a normal writer refuses to prepare or approve a negative material, record refused-at-setup; that negative still expects Graph contribution 0. A refused positive material makes the case Hold. A declared precondition that does not hold (such as a Raw membership or an ir-only IR admission that differs from the arms) records the affected variant as blocked:<precondition> instead; any other R or R+IR difference from the arms is Hold. Nothing is tuned and rerun.
measurementBoundary.rawPrediction: R is predicted from the single control Scene that quotes S2 verbatim; every other Scene shares no Raw-visible token with S2 (validator check). This prediction is the precondition raw-membership: a different Raw membership records the variant as blocked:raw-membership, not Hold. This version was written after v1's runtime was observed (IR did not admit v1's ir-only Scene, and one review Scene entered Raw through the relative rescue): it declares no ir-only Scene and gives qualified IR only to the control, so IR is not expected to use the shared slot, and the two review bodies were chosen by a pre-freeze model-only probe. It measures Graph's Scope exclusion and one-slot append on that premise and is not evidence of IR recall quality. IR is not assumed to attach to the control Scene.
